why_adversarial: Company sales: 10000 → 9000 (−10%). West −4000 is mostly offset by East +3000. share_of_change uses the net as denominator, so West can look like 4× the 'driver' of a modest company decline.
expected_analytic_behavior: Should not name West as the unique company-level primary_driver while East offsets most of the same move.
expected_claim_reviewer_behavior: A strong primary_driver claim on an offsetting pair is overclaim. Reviewer has no offsetting-segment check.
